answer: Any verified misbehavior slashes the bond, sending a ripple through the attacker's linked accounts, while honest peers retain an echo of their stake history as portable proof. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond that decays only at the nadir of its reputation curve, so a cluster of fake identities must fund every bond upfront. Copying one identity raises cost linearly, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
